short_description: Read unread count and the age of your oldest unread message without showing mail contents.
description: Read unread count and the age of your oldest unread message without showing mail contents. Configure IMAP host, port and folder. Set IMAP_USER and either IMAP_PASSWORD (an app password if required) or IMAP_OAUTH_TOKEN on the computer. STATUS reads UNSEEN. For age, a read-only selection requests only INTERNALDATE for unread message IDs, never message bodies or subjects. Providers must enable IMAP. Expired credentials yield an offline state; OAuth refresh is handled by the owner.
